drawio-viewer.min.js
=====================

Source: https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/dev/src/main/webapp/js/viewer.min.js
Vendored on: 2026-07-08 (unmodified, as fetched from the jgraph/drawio "dev" branch)

This file is part of the draw.io project (https://github.com/jgraph/drawio),
distributed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. The full license text is
reproduced below and also available at:
https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/dev/LICENSE

It is used here to render draw.io diagrams offline inside richtext fields,
with the same rendering engine as the draw.io application itself, instead of
a hand-written approximate SVG renderer. See specs/T47.md and
specs/T47-design.md for context.
